name: adt-editor-bridge
description: Hosts a localhost MCP server exposing write_source/read_source for ADT objects, via VS Code's official ADT FileSystemProvider. Dev-only. On-policy companion to the official SAP ADT MCP Server.

adtEditorBridge.port.description: Localhost (127.0.0.1) port for the MCP server.

adtEditorBridge.devSystemAllowlist.description: Allowlist of Dev ABAP destination IDs (e.g. YOUR_DEV_DEST). Any write/read whose URI resolves to a destination NOT on this list is refused. Empty = refuse everything.
